description: If elytra don't fully break, why should tools with Mending?

mods.name: NotFullyBroken
mods.description: In Minecraft, you can easily break your best tools if something distracts you. NotFullyBroken fixes that. Now, all tools with mending and 0 durability will change to their broken state, in which you can't use them. To move them out of the broken state, you simply recover them using XP.
